summary: Backend-only test of App Store zip download reliability from the EXTERNAL preview URL. Wrote pytest suite (/app/backend/tests/test_appstore_zip.py) covering static mount, fallback route, range request, zip validity, and legal-route regressions. All 7 tests PASSED. 5 consecutive hits on /api/static/appstore/blue-collar-alpha-appstore-6.5.zip returned HTTP 200 with full 4,518,276 bytes and Content-Type application/zip - no intermittent 503. Fallback /api/appstore/screenshots.zip also returned 200 with full body. Zip is a valid archive containing exactly the 5 expected PNGs (01_dashboard, 02_journal, 03_coach, 04_strategy, 05_market_sentiment). /api/legal/privacy and /api/legal/terms both return 200.

minor.issue: Server does not honor 'Range: bytes=0-1023' header - returns HTTP 200 with full 4.5MB body instead of 206 Partial Content. Not a blocker (test accepts 200 per spec, browsers still work) but ingress/StaticFiles is likely stripping the Range header. Consider verifying if Starlette StaticFiles range support is intact behind the ingress.

action_items: No action required - primary 503 concern is resolved. Optional: investigate why Range requests return 200 (full body) instead of 206; likely ingress-side but low priority since download works.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Zip downloads via both /api/static/appstore/... and /api/appstore/screenshots.zip are reliable from the external preview URL. If range-support is later required, verify Starlette StaticFiles behavior behind ingress (currently returns 200 full body for Range header).
rca_of_issue: Original 503 was transient (likely during backend restart). Fix (StaticFiles mount at /api/static + FileResponse fallback route) is working reliably - verified with 5 consecutive successful downloads and content validation.
